description: This file contains unit tests for URL redaction functions that identify and redact sensitive parts of URLs such as user credentials and tokens, as well as tests for related utility functions and config path recognition.

methods.name: redactSensitiveUrl
methods.description: Redacts user credentials and sensitive query parameters from URLs.

methods.name: redactSensitiveUrlLikeString
methods.description: Redacts URLs or URL-like strings, replacing sensitive parts with placeholders.

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlQueryParamName
methods.description: Checks if a query parameter name is considered sensitive (e.g., token, refresh_token).

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlConfigPath
methods.description: Determines if a configuration path may embed URL secrets.

methods.name: hasSensitiveUrlHintTag
methods.description: Checks whether a config object has an explicit 'url-secret' hint tag.
